Comment.MultiLanguageText: Suction trip latch C01/C02/C03/C05: XV-403 closed until RESET
Flare trip latch C01/C02/C03: XV-401 open until RESET
No trip latched: flare closed and suction open (HMI)
C04a: drain open too long, latched until RESET
C04b: LSHH-103 without LSH-102, latched until RESET
C06a / F44: E-STOP cause, latched until healthy RESET
C06a / F44: PSH-101 cause, latched until healthy RESET
C06a / F44: LSHH-103 cause, latched until healthy RESET
C06a / F44: power-up cause, latched until healthy RESET
C06a / 0007 D5: 0 none, 1 E-STOP, 2 PSH, 3 LSHH, 4 power-up

AttributeList.Text: Gas scrubber, docs/التشغيل.md §1
C04 — LSH-102 high level alarm
C03 — PSH-101 alarm
C05 — LSHH-103 alarm
C03 / C05 / C01 — RESET once every cause is gone
S-01 / C01 / C03 / C05 — suction trip (also at power-up)
S-01 / C01 / C03 — flare trip (also at power-up); LSHH does not open the flare
E5 — XV-401 flare (NO) energised = closed while no flare trip
E7 — XV-403 suction (NC) energised = open while no suction trip
S-01 — HMI: no trip latched
C04 / C05 — high level: LSH-102 or LSHH-103 open
C04 — drain demand after TDRN_ON of high level
C04 — drain demand off after TDRN_OFF without high level
C04a — drain open continuously for TDRN_MAX: close and alarm
C04a — RESET clears the drain timeout (drain follows level again)
E6 — XV-402 drain (NC) energised = open: demand, no E-STOP, no timeout
C04b — LSHH-103 open while LSH-102 healthy for 5 s: LSH-102 fault
C04b — RESET clears the LSH-102 fault once the switches agree
C06a / F44 / 0007 D5 — latch cause: E-STOP
C06a / F44 / 0007 D5 — latch cause: PSH-101
C06a / F44 / 0007 D5 — latch cause: LSHH-103
C06a / F44 / 0007 D5 — latch cause: power-up
C06a / F44 / 0007 D5 — first-out 1: E-STOP (only if none)
C06a / F44 / 0007 D5 — first-out 2: PSH-101 (only if none)
C06a / F44 / 0007 D5 — first-out 3: LSHH-103 (only if none)
C06a / F44 / 0007 D5 — first-out 4: power-up (only if none)
C06a / F44 / 0007 D5 — healthy RESET clears all causes and first-out last
